title: Run a load test before a major release
summary: Check in staging that a critical service handles the expected peak traffic before a major release, with the results stored so the next release can compare.

resources.title: Load test scripts
resources.description: k6 scripts and the peak traffic profile of every tier 0 service.

prerequisites.title: The release candidate is deployed to staging
prerequisites.description: The image version you plan to release runs in staging with production-like settings.

actors.name: You
actors.description: An engineer of the team that releases the service.

steps.title: Book the staging environment
instructions: Post the date and time of the test in #quality.
Check no other load test is planned at the same time.

steps.title: Set the traffic profile
instructions: Open the load-tests repository and find the folder of your service.
Set the peak requests per second from last year's busiest day plus 20%.

steps.title: Run the load test
steps.description: The test ramps up to the peak in 10 minutes and holds it for 30.

steps.title: Find and fix the bottleneck
instructions: Open the service dashboard for the time of the test.
Find what ran out first: CPU, memory, database connections or a dependency.
Fix it, deploy to staging and run the test again.

steps.title: Attach the results to the change record
instructions: Download the summary from the test run.
Attach it to the change record of the release.
